notes:
New/edit dimension (new in CHR-1062; the build has it, the experiment drawing did not). Same dialog shell as `usecases-edit-dialog`, 580px. Drawn: edit mode of "Project size" while a fourth value is being added.

Header: "Edit dimension" + id chip (create mode: "New dimension", no chip). Fields: Label (autofocus) | ID (derived from the label in create mode; "fixed once used", read-only in edit mode), Description (one line), Values ("· the ways users differ along this dimension"): one row per value — label input, the value id (mono, tertiary; derived from the label for new values, fixed for existing ones), remove; "+ Value" adds a row and focuses it. New dimensions start with two empty value rows.

Validation: Save is disabled while the payload is invalid (empty label, fewer than two values, duplicate ids); the first error shows in the footer message once the form is dirty. Footer: **Delete** (edit mode only, left, danger text; asks before deleting, focus on the safe action), Cancel, **Save dimension** / **Create dimension**.

Flows: close / Cancel / Save → `usecases-personas`.
